title: An innovative method of nonclinical efficacy and toxicological evaluation of recombinant Salmonella typhi Ty21a expressing HPV16 and 18 L1 proteins
author: Srinivasa Reddy, Narendra Babu, et al.

steps.title: Prepare anesthesia mixture
steps.instruction: Combine ketamine hydrochloride (62.5 mg/kg), xylazine hydrochloride (1.0 mg/kg) and diazepam (1.0 mg/kg) in a sterile graduated tube, mixing gently after each addition, then bring the solution to the final volume with sterile distilled water.

steps.title: Label and chill anesthesia
steps.instruction: Label the prepared anesthesia tubes and keep them on ice‑pack gels until use.

steps.title: Calculate individual doses
steps.instruction: Record the body weight of each animal, then aliquot the appropriate volume of anesthesia into 1.0 mL sterile syringes based on the calculated dose.

steps.title: Prepare animal for injection
steps.instruction: Place the animal in supine position by holding the tail (prone animal) with one hand and the dorsal‑neck skin with the other, then rotate 180°. Shave the lower abdominal quadrant (or hind‑limb thigh for rabbits) and swab with 70 % isopropyl alcohol; allow to dry.

steps.title: Administer anesthesia
steps.instruction: Inject 75–100 µL (mouse) or 750–1000 µL (rat) of the anesthesia solution intraperitoneally by inserting the needle into the lower abdominal skin at ~10° angle; inject 1.5–2.0 mL intramuscularly into the shaved hind‑limb thigh of rabbits.

steps.title: Allow anesthesia to take effect
steps.instruction: Wait 5–10 min for the unconscious stage, which persists for 20–30 min; then lay the animal supine with the head raised on a bedding husk.

steps.title: Reconstitute bacterial vaccine
steps.instruction: Rehydrate lyophilized S. typhi Ty21a and recombinant S. typhi Ty21a expressing HPV‑16/18 L1 (rSt.HPV) in sterile PBS under aseptic conditions.

steps.title: Determine bacterial concentration
steps.instruction: Plate three successive dilutions of each suspension in duplicate on Salmonella‑Shigella agar, incubate at 37 °C, enumerate colonies and express the result as CFU/mL.

steps.title: Prepare dosing suspensions
steps.instruction: Dilute the stock suspensions to the required dose levels: 50 × PD, 10 × PD, AD (5 × PD) and PD for mice, rats and rabbits.

steps.title: Perform qualitative urine analysis
steps.instruction: Collect urine before vaccine administration and at designated post‑exposure times; test for urobilinogen, protein, pH, RBC, specific gravity, ketone, bilirubin and glucose using Ames Multistix reagent strips (Siemens).
